planets.name: GJ 3090 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of GJ 3090 with a 2.85-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: GJ 3090 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around GJ 3090. Its orbit and size follow Lamontagne et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
